name: Next.js Portfolio Template
summary: Bento-grid Next.js portfolio template driven by one JSON file, with dev.to blog, full SEO and dark mode.
description: A bento-grid developer portfolio template built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion. One JSON content file drives most of the site; sub-pages cover experience, skills, projects, education/certifications and a blog fed from dev.to at build/ISR time. Metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt, generated social images and a dark/light mode with circular reveal are included.
contains: bento home page with hero, skills, experience, projects and blog tiles
sub-pages: experience, skills, projects, trail, blog, extensions
single portfolio.json drives almost all content
auto blog pulls dev.to posts at build/ISR time
OG image and favicon rendered at the edge
dark/light mode with circular reveal transition
deploys free on Vercel with no backend
